finding: MM304 projected crossrange only through roll reversal, not through arrest of sideways velocity. A 34-degree KSC return stayed on the wrong bank while still south of the runway, then arrived north of the site. The measured stopping-distance calculation existed but was disabled by default.
changes: Enable measured-lift crossrange arrest prediction by default; explicit KSP_LANDER_ENTRY_LATERAL_ARREST_TEST=0 retains a controlled comparison.
Native deorbit trials include safe, closing nearby inlets despite negative analytic inlet reserve or non-perpendicular course.
Compare completed native recovery attempts by ground endpoint, preserving certified capture priority and never counting a close high-altitude overflight as landing.

validation.focused: Entry stopping-distance bank reversal, safe oblique terminal trial, completed ground-endpoint ranking, high-altitude overflight rejection.
validation.l5: Original-source and wide-inlet patch simulator summaries identical; L5 still completes runway landing and rollout.

limitations: All new-flight evidence is offline; no game controls, reload, or live launch were sent.
The full native continuation models Final/Touchdown/Rollout; it is not the independent spring-damper ground simulator and does not prove stopped-on-runway rollout.
Nominal full-route and robustness certificates remain false; no safety or Final admission limit was relaxed.
Native trace endSpeed is inertial velocity magnitude, approximately253m/s here. The trajectory records air-relative speed, approximately83m/s at Touchdown; do not confuse them.
Historical aerodynamic cells, UT/state discontinuities and manual post-MM305 engine firings are not replayed by the envelope-based frozen counterfactual.
